title: TestLoginCredentialsRequest
description: Admin-only request completing a credential-based (LDAP/Basic) Test Login. The credentials are used for a single transient bind or password verification and are never persisted, logged, or used to create a session.

testSessionId.description: Identifier returned when the test login was started.

email.description: Email to authenticate with, exactly as it would be entered on the login page.

password.description: Password to authenticate with. Used once and discarded.
